$comment: The retired gate warden's house, and the quietest room in Crownspire. Forty years of one-word log entries -- OPEN, fourteen thousand times -- and six lines at the end that are not that word. The Frostnip on the floor is a mountain Kin that came down into the city and has been let stay; it is a drawn object on the map, not an encounter.

lines: Forty years I wrote one word in that book every morning and the word was OPEN.
My son writes it now. He has written a different one six times and he comes here afterwards.
She had the chair at the window facing the mountain. I turned it to face the fire.
She turned it back. I turned it round again. We have not spoken about it once.
It walked in on Tuesday. Gran opened the door for it and did not say anything.
It sits there. It will not go near the window. Gran will not go near the window either.
